speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sustained sensation of the room spinning. I also have Occasional nausea, Use of diphenhydramine for symptoms and to aid sleep, Recent cold. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The patient describes a sustained spinning sensation and has used diphenhydramine, but the history of a recent cold and the specific nature of the dizziness strongly suggest a vestibular issue rather than the progressive neurological symptoms of Multiple Sclerosis. To confirm the diagnosis, I need to know if your dizziness is triggered specifically by changes in head position, such as rolling over in bed or looking up.
